title: 第九章 双线惊涛
content_zh:
月氏的密信像一块冰，砸在刚有暖意的朝堂上。

    信纸是用月氏特有的桑皮纸做的，边缘粗糙，上面的字迹却凌厉如刀：“罗刹国若不交出异客陈默，三日后，铁骑踏破都城，玉石俱焚。”

    陈默捏着信纸的手微微颤抖，不是因为害怕，而是因为不解。月氏与罗刹国虽有摩擦，却素来井水不犯河水，为何突然要对自己动兵？

    “定是赵虎的余党搞的鬼！”老将军秦苍一拍案几，花白的胡须气得发抖，“那厮被擒前，曾暗中派人与月氏的丞相勾结，定是他们许诺了好处，让月氏国王来抢人！”

    阿蛮坐在陈默身边，脸色虽仍苍白，眼神却异常冷静：“秦将军说得有理。月氏国王昏聩，耳根子软，最听丞相的话。而月氏丞相与赵虎是旧识，早就想除掉陈默这个‘变数’。”她顿了顿，看向陈默，“他们要的是你，或许……”

    “或许我该去月氏一趟。”陈默接过话，目光坚定。

    朝堂上顿时一片反对声。

    “不可！月氏狼子野心，您去了就是羊入虎口！”

    “我们刚平定内乱，兵力不足，怎能让您以身犯险？”

    陈默抬手，示意大家安静：“月氏的目标是我，若我不去，战火一开，受苦的是两国百姓。更何况，我去了，未必是羊入虎口。”他看向蒙烈，“蒙兄，你熟悉月氏，敢不敢跟我走一趟？”

    蒙烈咧嘴一笑，露出爽朗的笑：“你去哪，我去哪！当年在驿站能救你一次，到了月氏，照样能把你从国王眼皮子底下捞出来！”

    阿蛮看着陈默，知道他一旦决定的事，十头牛都拉不回来。她握住他的手，指尖冰凉：“我给你三千精兵，埋伏在边境，若三日内没有你的消息，我就亲自带兵过去。”

    陈默点头，心里却暖得发疼。他知道，这是她能给他的最大底气。

    出发前夜，陈默去了静心苑。

    阿蛮正在灯下翻看医书，肩膀上的箭伤还没好利索，抬手时还会牵动伤口，眉头微微蹙着。陈默走过去，从她手里拿过书，替她揉了揉肩膀。

    “轻点……”阿蛮嗔了他一句，声音却软得像棉花。

    “还疼？”

    “好多了，”阿蛮转过身，看着他，“月氏丞相叫乌桓，是个老狐狸，表面和善，心里比赵虎还狠。他要是问起你在星火谷做的事，千万别说实话，就说那些都是蒙烈的功劳。”

    “我知道，”陈默点头，“你在都城也要当心，赵虎的余党还没清干净，别再受伤了。”

    “嗯，”阿蛮低下头，从抽屉里拿出一个小盒子，打开，里面是一枚玉佩，和前太子给陈默的那枚很像，只是上面刻的不是密道，而是一只展翅的鸟，“这是我母亲留给我的，说能保平安。你带上。”

    陈默接过玉佩，触手温润，像她的手。他把玉佩系在脖子上，贴在胸口，能感受到那点暖意。

    “等我回来，”他看着她的眼睛，“回来之后，我们就废除那些以丑为美的规矩，让罗刹国的人，不管长什么样，都能抬起头走路。”

    阿蛮的眼圈红了，点了点头，没说话。

    三日后，月氏都城外的十里坡。

    陈默和蒙烈只带了十个护卫，骑着马，在约定的地点等。远处扬起一阵尘土，月氏的使者带着一队人马过来了，为首的正是月氏丞相乌桓。

    乌桓看起来五十多岁，身材微胖，脸上堆着笑，眼睛却像鹰隼一样，把陈默从头到脚打量了一遍：“陈先生果然守信，真是英雄出少年啊。”他的汉语说得流利，却带着一股说不出的虚伪。

    “乌丞相过奖，”陈默淡淡一笑，“不知国王陛下找我，有何要事？”

    “陛下听闻陈先生有通天之能，能让铁飞，能让粮增产，特意请您来宫里坐坐，聊聊治国之道，”乌桓笑着做了个“请”的手势，“马车已经备好了，请吧。”

    陈默看了蒙烈一眼，蒙烈冲他使了个眼色，示意没问题。两人上了马车，护卫们则被乌桓的人“请”到了别处休息——明摆着是软禁。

    马车里铺着厚厚的羊毛毯，却让人感觉不到丝毫暖意。乌桓闭目养神，看似随意地问：“听说陈先生在星火谷，教那些匠人做了不少新奇玩意儿？”

    “不过是些糊口的小把戏，当不得乌丞相的面说。”陈默打着哈哈。

    “哦？”乌桓睁开眼，嘴角的笑深了些，“比如能看清远处的镜子？能省力的铁架子？这些要是用到战场上，可是能抵千军万马啊。”

    陈默心里一凛，果然，他们盯上的是星火谷的技术。

    “丞相说笑了，”陈默不动声色，“那些东西只能用来种地、做买卖，哪能上战场？再说，我一个异乡人，只想安稳度日，哪敢掺和这些？”

    乌桓没再追问，只是笑了笑，闭上眼睛。马车在寂静的街道上行驶，陈默的心却越来越沉——他总觉得，事情没那么简单。

    ***与此同时，罗刹国都城。

    阿蛮正在批阅奏折，突然听到外面传来一阵喧哗。她放下笔，走到窗边，只见一队禁军匆匆跑过，神色慌张。

    “出了什么事？”她问侍女小翠。

    小翠脸色发白，跑进来：“公主殿下，不好了！黑风岭那边传来消息，说……说赵虎的余党聚众谋反，已经攻下了两个县城，正向都城杀来！”

    阿蛮的心猛地一沉。黑风岭是赵虎的老家，那里的人大多信奉以丑为美，对赵虎忠心耿耿。她没想到，这些余党居然敢在这个时候叛乱！
content_en:
Yuezhi's secret letter was like a piece of ice hitting the newly warm court hall.
The letter paper was made of Yuezhi's unique mulberry paper, with rough edges, but the writing on it was as sharp as a knife: "If the Rakshasa Kingdom does not hand over the stranger Chen Mo, in three days, the cavalry will trample the capital, and everyone will be burned."
Chen Mo's hand holding the letter trembled slightly, not because of fear, but because of confusion.Although there are conflicts between the Yuezhi and the Rakshasa Kingdom, they have always been in harmony with each other. Why do they suddenly want to launch an army against them?
"It must be Zhao Hu's remnant party!" The old general Qin Cang slapped the case, his gray beard trembling with anger, "Before that guy was captured, he secretly sent people to collude with the Yuezhi Prime Minister. They must have promised benefits and let the Yuezhi King come to rob him!"
Aman sat next to Chen Mo. Although his face was still pale, his eyes were extremely calm: "General Qin is right. King Yueshi is dim and soft-eared, and he listens to the Prime Minister's words the most. Prime Minister Yueshi and Zhao Hu are old acquaintances, and they have long wanted to get rid of Chen Mo as a 'variable.'" She paused and looked at Chen Mo, "What they want is you, maybe..."
"Maybe I should go to Yueshi." Chen Mo took over the words with a firm gaze.
There was a sudden burst of opposition in the court.
"No! The Yuezhi is so ambitious that if you go, you will be like a sheep in a tiger's mouth!"
"We have just put down the civil strife and we don't have enough troops. How can we let you put yourself in danger?"
Chen Mo raised his hand and signaled everyone to be quiet: "The target of the Yueshi is me. If I don't go, if the war breaks out, the people of both countries will suffer. What's more, if I go, it may not be a sheep in the tiger's mouth." He looked at Meng Lie, "Brother Meng, you are familiar with the Yueshi, do you dare to come with me?"
Meng Lie grinned and showed a hearty smile: "Wherever you go, I will go! I could save you once at the inn, but when I get to Yuezhi, I can still get you out from under the king's nose!"
Ah Man looked at Chen Mo and knew that once he decided on something, even ten cows would not be able to hold him back.She held his hand, her fingertips were cold: "I will give you three thousand elite soldiers to ambush at the border. If there is no news from you within three days, I will personally lead the troops there."
Chen Mo nodded, but his heart ached with warmth.He knew that this was the greatest confidence she could give him.
The night before departure, Chen Mo went to Jingxinyuan.
Ah Man was reading a medical book under the lamp. The arrow wound on his shoulder had not been healed yet. When he raised his hand, the wound would be affected. His brows were slightly frowned.Chen Mo walked over, took the book from her hand, and rubbed her shoulders.
"Be gentle..." Aman scolded him, but his voice was as soft as cotton.
"Still hurts?"
"Much better," Ah Man turned around and looked at him, "The Prime Minister of the Yue clan is called Wu Huan. He is an old fox. He is kind on the surface, but more ruthless than Zhao Hu on the inside. If he asks you about what you did in Xinghuo Valley, don't tell the truth. Just say that it was Meng Lie's credit."
"I know," Chen Mo nodded, "You have to be careful in the capital. Zhao Hu's remnants haven't been wiped out yet, so don't get hurt again."
"Well," Ah Man lowered his head, took out a small box from the drawer, and opened it. Inside was a jade pendant, which was very similar to the one the former prince gave to Chen Mo, except that instead of a secret passage, it was engraved with a bird spreading its wings. "This is what my mother left for me. She said it can keep her safe. You take it with you."
Chen Mo took the jade pendant, and his tentacles were as gentle as hers.He tied the jade pendant around his neck and pressed it against his chest, feeling the warmth.
"When I come back," he looked into her eyes, "when I come back, we will abolish those rules that regard ugliness as beauty, so that people in the Rakshasa Kingdom can hold their heads up and walk, no matter what they look like."
Ah Man's eyes were red and he nodded without saying anything.
Three days later, Shilipo outside the Yuezhi capital city.
Chen Mo and Meng Lie only brought ten guards with them, riding horses and waiting at the agreed place.A puff of dust rose in the distance, and the Yuezhi's envoy came over with a group of people. The leader was none other than Wuhuan, the Yuezhi Prime Minister.
Wu Huan looked to be in his fifties, slightly chubby, with a smile on his face, but his eyes were like a falcon. He looked at Chen Mo from head to toe: "Mr. Chen is indeed trustworthy. He is truly a hero from a young age." He spoke Chinese fluently, but with an indescribable hypocrisy.
"Prime Minister Wu, thank you." Chen Mo smiled lightly, "I wonder why His Majesty the King wants to see me for something important?"
"Your Majesty heard that Mr. Chen has extraordinary powers, can make iron fly, and increase grain production. He specially invites you to come and sit in the palace and talk about the ways of governing the country." Wu Huan smiled and made a "please" gesture, "The carriage is ready, please come."
Chen Mo glanced at Meng Lie, and Meng Lie winked at him, indicating that it was okay.The two got on the carriage, and the guards were "invited" by Wuhuan's people to rest elsewhere - obviously under house arrest.
The carriage was covered with thick woolen blankets, but there was no warmth at all.Wu Huan closed his eyes and rested, and asked seemingly casually: "I heard that Mr. Chen taught the craftsmen in Xinghuo Valley to make many novel things?"
"It's just a little trick to make ends meet. You can't tell it in front of Prime Minister Wu." Chen Mo laughed.
"Oh?" Wu Huan opened his eyes, and the smile on his lips deepened, "For example, a mirror that can see clearly in the distance? An iron frame that can save labor? If these are used on the battlefield, they can withstand thousands of troops."
Chen Mo was shocked. Sure enough, they were eyeing Spark Valley's technology.
"The Prime Minister is joking," Chen Mo said calmly, "Those things can only be used for farming and doing business, how can they be used on the battlefield? Besides, I am a foreigner who just wants to live a stable life, how can I dare to get involved in this?"
Wu Huan didn't ask any more questions, just smiled and closed his eyes.As the carriage drove along the quiet street, Chen Mo's heart became heavier and heavier - he always felt that things were not that simple.
***At the same time, the capital of Rakshasa Kingdom.
Ah Man was reviewing the memorial when he suddenly heard a commotion outside.She put down her pen and walked to the window, only to see a group of forbidden soldiers running past in a panic.
"What happened?" she asked the maid Xiao Cui.
Xiaocui's face turned pale and she ran in: "Your Highness Princess, it's not good! There is news from Heifeng Ridge that... Zhao Hu's remnant party has gathered to rebel, has captured two county towns, and is heading towards the capital!"
Ah Man's heart suddenly sank.Heifengling is Zhao Hu's hometown. Most people there believe that ugliness is beauty and are loyal to Zhao Hu.She didn't expect that these remnants of the party would dare to rebel at this time!
